name: traveler-v1
chrf_floor_note: Calibrated from the NEU-61 kickoff sweep: measured corpus chrF 80.3 on the published v2.0.0 pack; floor = max(15.0, min(0.45 * chrF, chrF - 20)). A direction-mislabeled pack collapses far below this value (see the es-en adversarial control).

entries.reference: I need 3 tickets for tomorrow morning.
There are 5 of us, including 2 children.
My phone number is 0044 7788 123456.
The flight takes 9 hours and 25 minutes.

entries.source: Meitä on 4 ihmistä ja meillä on 6 matkalaukkua.
entries.reference: We are 4 people and we have 6 suitcases.
Room 214 is on the second floor.
I arrived on October 3 and I leave on October 9.
What time does the museum open on Sundays?
My train leaves at 18:45 from platform 7.

entries.source: Viimeinen bussi lähtee kello 23:30 tänä iltana.
entries.reference: The last bus leaves at 23:30 tonight.

entries.source: Minulla on varaus kello 20 kahdelle hengelle.
entries.reference: I have a reservation at 8 pm for 2 people.
Does the pharmacy open before 9 in the morning?

entries.source: Kierros alkaa kello 14:15 ja kestää 3 tuntia.
entries.reference: The tour starts at 14:15 and lasts 3 hours.
Breakfast is served from 6:30 to 10:00.

entries.source: Paljonko kahden hengen huone maksaa 3 yöksi?
entries.reference: How much is a double room for 3 nights?
This costs 45 euros, including tax.
Is there a discount for 2 adults and 1 child?
The ticket costs 12.50 euros per person.
Can I pay the 78 euros by card?
How much is the airport shuttle for 2 people?

entries.source: Päivän menu maksaa 15 euroa juoma sisältyy.
entries.reference: The menu of the day is 15 euros with a drink included.

entries.source: Osoite on Calle Mayor 15, kolmas kerros.
entries.reference: The address is Calle Mayor 15, third floor.

entries.source: Hotellini on Gran Vía 28:ssa, lähellä metroasemaa.
entries.reference: My hotel is at 28 Gran Vía, near the metro.

entries.source: Suurlähetystö on osoitteessa Paseo de la Castellana 259.
entries.reference: The embassy is at Paseo de la Castellana 259.
Please write down the address: number 42, apartment 5B.

entries.source: Tapaamispaikka on Plaza del Sol, portti 3.
entries.reference: The meeting point is Plaza del Sol, gate 3.

entries.source: Onko tämä tie Carrer de Balmes 112:een?
entries.reference: Is this the way to Carrer de Balmes 112?
Where is the nearest bus stop?

entries.source: Kääntykää liikennevaloista vasemmalle ja jatkakaa sitten 200 metriä suoraan.
entries.reference: Turn left at the traffic lights, then go straight for 200 meters.
Is the station within walking distance of the hotel?

entries.source: Mikä linja menee lentokentälle, linja 5 vai linja 8?
entries.reference: Which line goes to the airport, line 5 or line 8?
Excuse me, is this seat 14A?
How do I get to the old town from here?

entries.source: Museo on noin 15 minuutin kävelymatkan päässä aukiolta.
entries.reference: The museum is about 15 minutes on foot from the square.
Please call an ambulance, someone is unconscious.
I have lost my passport and my wallet.

entries.source: Missä on lähin sairaala tai klinikka?
entries.reference: Where is the nearest hospital or clinic?

entries.source: Olen allerginen maapähkinöille; sisältääkö tämä ruoka niitä?
entries.reference: I am allergic to peanuts; does this dish contain any?

entries.source: Joku varasti laukkuni, jossa oli 200 euroa.
entries.reference: Someone stole my bag with 200 euros inside.

entries.source: Soittakaa poliisi, kiitos. On sattunut onnettomuus.
entries.reference: Call the police, please. There has been an accident.
